headline: Senators' Hayden Hodgson ejected after hitting Kings' Brandt Clarke into boards
take:
Per ESPN, Senators forward Hayden Hodgson drove the Kings' Brandt Clarke into the boards in the second period Thursday night, earning a major penalty and a game misconduct. Daily Faceoff reports that Clarke then left the game with an upper-body injury.

Clarke's absence would hurt a Kings team that is 3-6-2. At five-on-five, LAK have created 55.74% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) with Clarke on the ice so far this season, and the team's share is about 14 points better with him out there than without him. He averages 19.93 minutes a game, and his three goals are well above the 0.84 expected from his own chances, so some of his 8 points likely reflect finishing luck. The defensive impact looks more durable than the scoring. We don't have a minutes projection to share, so watch who picks up his shifts if he sits.

For OTT, Hodgson is a fourth-line player averaging 5.19 minutes over 4 games, so his suspension risk matters more than his absence would.
